records: CFTC August 31 2026 FCM financial data are a month-end selected-data snapshot from reports filed by October 1, 2026. They are not a live October balance sheet and do not identify asset/token composition.

CFTC FCM adjusted net capital, net capital requirement, customer assets in segregation and excess segregated funds are different regulatory measures. Customer funds aggregate money, securities and property across customer product categories; none is XRP-specific.

Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC and Coinbase Financial Markets Inc. are separate FCM legal entities with different products, customer mixes and statutory account classes. Comparing their totals does not establish consolidated group size, XRP exposure, market share or cash available for investment.

Hidden Road's October 20 daily segregation statement reports $667.976M in segregation and $633.790M cash margins on deposit with DCOs, but does not identify tokens or asset composition. Its zero securities lines do not by themselves prove that no XRP was held elsewhere or under another classification.

Ripple's month-end net-capital-history page labels a field 'minimum net capital requirement'; the CFTC monthly report's net-capital requirement applies a greater-of calculation across several regulatory requirements. Their adjusted net capital figures agree within $1 for August, but the requirement/excess fields are not directly comparable.

Coinbase Financial Markets FCM capital and customer funds are not Coinbase Global consolidated cash, assets, USDC balances or XRP inventory. Summing separate 4d(a)(2), Part 30 and cleared-swap customer account categories is only a reporting aggregate; the accounts are not one fungible pool.

Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan) is distinct from SBI Holdings and SBI Ripple Asia. Its ChatGPT seminar is educational; the official material reviewed does not establish an OpenAI partnership or direct Ripple/XRP investment.
